Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

Rounds cause extra damage to combatants' shields and overpenetrate targets. 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Assault Mag
perks.desc:
This shotgun's magazine is optimized for quick combat.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases rate of fire

perks.name: High-Caliber Rounds
perks.desc:
Shots from this weapon knock the target back farther.
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.desc: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Collective Pugilism
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Loose Change
perks.desc: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for a short duration.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.desc: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Master of Arms
perks.desc: Kills with any weapon improve this weapon's damage for a short time.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.desc: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

perks.name: Vanguard Determination
perks.desc: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.desc: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.

notes: //notes:Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly when paired with Sturm in the kinetic slot. Drang is good as far as primary sidearms go, but they do still fall in the shadow of their Micro missile frame cousins. This is an adaptive frame underneath, but has the additional Together Forever frame intrinsic, which loads overcharged rounds into Sturm on kills. In return, kills with Sturm refill energy slot weapons from reserves and, with the Helping Hands catalyst boost Range by +18 and Handling by +40 for faster swaps. The stats are good by comparison with its adaptive frame peers, which are helped at Tier 4/5 when barrel and magazine perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/358190158 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. From the @Mossy-Max spreadsheet at https://www.destiny2.science/ base Magazine size is 18 (max 20). Handling is pretty good, so on M+KB, you can probably look to extend the range a bit with the barrel perk - you can squeeze another 1-2m before damage drop-off depending on how much you invest into it, even at the cost of a Handling malus. With the Sturm pairing to bypass reload, you can use the magazine perk to boost magazine size. The first column trait perk that stands out for the pairing with Sturm is Disruption Break which increases kinetic damage by ×1.5 after breaking an elemental shield. For damage, Binary Orbit - provides a ×1.25 damage boost for 8.5s (10.5s enhanced) after a kill with an opposing elemental alignment - Stasis, Strand or, when paired with Sturm, kinetic. Alternatively, Master of Arms provides ×1.15 damage for 7s (8s enhanced) after a kill with any weapon, with a second stack of ×1.25 for 4s (5s enhanced) on any kills with the first stack active or Frenzy boosts Handling and Reload Speed by +100 and damage by ×1.15 for a refreshable 7.2s after being in combat for 12s - that's dealing or taking damage. For the Origin Trait, there's either Vanguard Vindication to provide up to 3 stacks of ×0.98/0.96/0.94 damage reduction for 10s, for kills within 20s of using a class ability, or Roar of Battle which grants +10 Stability and Handling for 6s, after dealing or taking damage every 0.5s or so for 2s. Recommended MW: Range, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly when paired with Sturm in the kinetic slot and using a solar build. Drang is good as far as primary sidearms go, but they do still fall in the shadow of their Micro missile frame cousins. This is an adaptive frame underneath, but has the additional Together Forever frame intrinsic, which loads overcharged rounds into Sturm on kills. In return, kills with Sturm refill energy slot weapons from reserves and, with the Helping Hands catalyst boost Range by +18 and Handling by +40 for faster swaps. The stats are good by comparison with its adaptive frame peers, which are helped at Tier 4/5 when barrel and magazine perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/358190158 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. From the @mossy_max spreadsheet at https://www.destiny2.science/ base Magazine size is 18 (max 20). Handling is pretty good, so on M+KB, you can probably look to extend the range a bit with the barrel perk - you can squeeze another 1-2m before damage drop-off depending on how much you invest into it, even at the cost of a Handling malus. With the Sturm pairing to bypass reload, you can use the magazine perk to boost magazine size. To pair with solar builds, you have the traditional trait perk pairings available. In the first column, Heal Clip provides ×2 Cure (140 HP), and ×1 Cure on allies within 15m, when you finish a reload within ~5.3s (~5.5s when enhanced) after a kill. Then in the second there's Incandescent which spreads +30 Scorch stacks within 4m on a red bar Minor add kill (+40 stacks within 8m for orange and yellow bars, +45 when enhanced). Alternatively, Burning Ambition works better to build ignitions on tougher targets if you have a solar ability to apply scorch initially, otherwise it'll take x* hits (y* when enhanced) to apply +10 stacks with +10 added on each additional hit to build towards an ignition. All of the scorch stacks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. For the Origin Trait, there's either Vanguard Vindication to provide up to 3 stacks of ×0.98/0.96/0.94 damage reduction for 10s, for kills within 20s of using a class ability, or Roar of Battle which grants +10 Stability and Handling for 6s, after dealing or taking damage every 0.5s or so for 2s. Recommended MW: Range, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
